Source follow-up: Fresh extraction from supplied published-article text; title and authors match the assigned reference. Published version supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Requested test statistic retained without conversion. Both inputs identify Study 5A; the focal attitudes interaction is on published p. 208 (article page 13). Enrollment n is printed in words on p. 207; its applicability to the target ANOVA is corroborated by the stated four-cell design and residual df, rather than assumed solely from a generic paper total. Study 5A assesses processing via argument-quality sensitivity; later resistance is not a measured outcome in this study. Replication and reported_success deliberately unexamined under the original-only override. The neutral description is broad; selection uses its Study 5A identifier and p. 208 locator, and the primary Results—Attitudes interaction.
